hypothesis: When Coinbase and the Chainlink resolver stream agree while direct Binance is the lagging outlier, an unadjusted Polymarket crypto binary may briefly lag the resolver-aware quorum after executable costs.

mechanism.markets: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP five-minute direction binaries
mechanism.quorum: Coinbase and Chainlink same sign, each >=2.5bp over 10s, within 2.5bp of each other
mechanism.outlier: quorum minus direct Binance has the quorum sign and magnitude >=2.5bp
mechanism.execution: real CLOB ask, event_order_250ms quote-survival model, <=20% displayed touch, $10 cap
mechanism.economic_gate: at least $0.02 probability edge per share after 2x crypto taker fees
mechanism.exit: hold to terminal resolution; no interim mark-price stop

selection_disclosure: The mechanism was selected after reviewing H1-H51 pilot results. No H49 or legacy Main observation counts as evidence for this new strategy ID. Multiple-testing correction must include all prior hypotheses and discarded variants.
decision_rule: After at least 500 independent markets and 14 calendar days, require >=90% non-F data quality, positive 2x-cost PnL in both chronological halves, a multiple-testing-adjusted market-clustered lower confidence bound above zero, and non-negative 5s/30s adverse selection. Otherwise reject or redesign under a new strategy ID.
zero_edge_disclosure: A valid result is that the apparent pilot edge disappears and measured exploitable edge is approximately zero.
